    Name the trail your Ranger follows

    The class behind the name

    The early class reveal described the long-range scout as Marksman; the March 2026 announcement used Ranger and introduced Supporting Fire.

    Sources: NCSOFT class reveal, June 2025 · March 2026 class update. Historical context; skill names and availability may differ by region or update.

    Both descriptions point toward distance, observation and covering an ally. A landscape, a bird or a trail can make your archer feel like a traveler with a home.

    The woodland scout

    Choose one natural root and a light ending. Fenara suggests a wetland traveler; Liren feels airy without spelling out a weapon. A place-inspired name works well if you want an identity beyond archery.

    The watchful marksman

    Hawk, quill, trail and arrow make clear aliases. Pair one with a direction of light or a darker landscape. Avoid combining three nature words: the image becomes harder to picture.

    Frequently Asked Questions

    What are good Ranger names for Aion 2?

    Fenara suggests a landscape, Dawnhawk suggests a lookout, and Raventrail suggests a patient tracker. Start with the place or creature you want to evoke, then keep the name focused on that image.

    Does the generator check if a Ranger name is available?

    No tool outside the game can check live availability. Generate a shortlist, save your favorites with the ☆ button, then try them at character creation. If one is taken, use ↻ to get spelling variants.

    How do I use the Ranger name generator?

    The class is already set to Ranger. Choose Elyos or Asmodian, pick a gender and tone, then hit Generate. Click any name to copy it, or ☆ to save it to your shortlist.
